subject: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@acme-tech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)

Thanks for taking the time today, Sam — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Summary: Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference serving across internal product teams (initial pilot ~50k tokens/month). Key procurement items to confirm: PO vs card, net terms, invoice format, VAT/tax handling, billing contact/address, and marketplace interest (AWS Marketplace).
- Action items we agreed on: you'll confirm whether procurement requires a PO and provide the billing address + VAT ID (if applicable). We'll confirm whether we can support the requested invoice format and net terms.

I've attached an initial quote (redwood_quote_v1.pdf) and our standard invoice template to show the fields we can populate. Can you confirm the following so we can route to Finance/Legal: 

1) Procurement path: PO (manual purchase order), credit card, or AWS Marketplace?
2) If PO: will Acme need our invoices to include a PO number on the invoice?
3) Net terms: does Acme require Net 30/45/60?
4) Billing address and billing contact name + email
5) VAT / tax requirements: are you VAT-registered? Do you need VAT shown on the invoice or reverse-charge treatment?

If you're leaning toward marketplace procurement, we can share the marketplace listing details and discuss billing flow (marketplace invoicing vs direct).

Next step from our side: I'll loop in Finance to confirm net terms and invoice customization options once you confirm the above. If it helps, we can also initiate the order form and DocuSign flow while procurement finalizes PO details.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_quote_v1.pdf (PDF, 32KB)

From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@acme-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acme-tech.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few answers from our side: 

1) Procurement path: We'd prefer to purchase via PO (standard for vendor onboarding here). We do consider Marketplace for some purchases, but procurement prefers direct PO for platform contracts.
2) PO number: yes, please include our PO number on the invoice (will provide PO once Legal clears).
3) Net terms: Acme requests Net 30.
4) Billing address / contact: 
   Company: Acme Technology, Inc.
   Billing contact: Alyssa Chen (alyssa.chen@acme-tech.com, +1 212-555-0199)
   Billing address: 120 Park Ave, 6th Floor, New York, NY 10105
5) VAT/tax: Acme is US-based; no VAT ID required. However, if we pursue EMEA pilots later, we'll surface VAT requirements then.

I've attached our standard PO template for your ops team to review (acme_po_45321.pdf). 

Two quick clarifications: 
- Invoice line items: Procurement typically wants SKU-level line items and a monthly usage breakdown if possible. Can you provide an invoice that shows SKU/description, unit price, quantity, and a monthly subtotal?
- Marketplace: interested, but not necessary right now. If Redwood supports AWS Marketplace billing with direct pass-through and consolidated invoicing, we can evaluate separately.

If you're able to accept PO + Net 30 and provide the invoice fields requested, we can move to generate a PO and sign the order form.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Bennett
Head of Procurement | Acme Technology
sam.bennett@acme-tech.com

Attachment: acme_po_45321.pdf (PDF, 14KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)

Looping finance/ops — see Acme's answers below. Key asks: PO on invoice, Net 30, SKU-level invoice lines, monthly usage breakdown. They attached their PO template.

Neha / Vivek — can Finance confirm: 
- We can accept PO + Net 30 for a pilot-sized commit (~50k tokens/month)? Any minimums required for Net terms?
- Can our billing ops produce invoice with SKU-level lines and usage breakdown (we already do this for some customers, but want to confirm formatting constraints)?
- Marketplace: if they later ask for AWS Marketplace billing, what are our options (managed listing vs private offers)?

Thanks — David

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@acme-tech.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)

Hi Sam — thanks for the quick responses and for sending the PO template. 

Short answers: 
- PO + Net 30: confirmed. Finance is comfortable accepting a PO and Net 30 for this pilot (no minimum required for Net 30 on initial pilot). Vivek, thanks for the quick check.
- Invoice fields: we can include SKU-level line items and a monthly usage breakdown. I've attached our invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.pdf) that shows the SKU, description, unit price, quantity, subtotal, tax line (if applicable), and a free-text PO number field. If you need any specific column headings, send them over and we'll align.
- VAT / tax: since Acme is US-based, no VAT handling is necessary for now. If EMEA expansion comes up, we'll discuss reverse-charge and VAT IDs then.
- Marketplace: we support AWS Marketplace listings; however, for this contract the simpler path is direct PO. If you'd like, we can provide a comparison doc for Marketplace vs direct invoicing (billing cadence and fees differ).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Acme to generate PO (please include a PO number and billing contact on the PO).
2) We'll prepare the order form and send via DocuSign. You can elect to sign the order form and then attach the PO to the invoice, or include the PO number in the DocuSign order form.
3) Once signed, Finance will issue the first invoice per the agreed cadence (monthly) with the PO number included.

DocuSign link (order form draft): https://www.docusign.net/transaction/details/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Let me know if that works and I'll kick off the DocuSign flow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_invoice_template.pdf (PDF, 8KB)

From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@acme-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@acme-tech.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & billing requirements (PO, net terms, invoice format)

Perfect — that workflow sounds good. We'll generate the PO today and include the billing contact. Our PO number will be ACME-PO-45321. 

Please proceed with the DocuSign order form and include a PO number field. Once we sign, Finance will process the first invoice under Net 30. Confirm the invoice should be sent to accounts-payable@acme-tech.com. 

One small request: please include our PO number on every invoice and include a short usage detail line (month, SKU, tokens) so our procurement system can reconcile automatically.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Sam
